title: Little Fish: Four Times a Knight
content:
Anna gives a huge spoiler to one of Andy's novels, while they and James discuss YOUR facts. This week's subjects include Google, bloopers, Kenyan elephants and Kurt Vonnegut. And the gang announce eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians. (Apologies for the audio quality this week - our microphones failed, but we hope the amazing batch of facts distracts you from it!)

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

Edited by James Harkin

Produced by Leying Lee

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
